pages.text: Pattern scrolls are the mod's knowledge: each teaches exactly one symbol. Most belong on gems; $(l:socket-sorcery:patterns/ring_triggers)Ring Trigger$() scrolls belong on rings. They cannot be crafted — adventurers before you left them in $(thing)dungeons$(), $(thing)mineshafts$(), $(thing)desert and jungle temples$(), $(thing)strongholds$(), $(thing)woodland mansions$() and $(thing)buried treasure$().
A scroll is consumed when its pattern is successfully engraved, so spend them with care. Its tooltip names the pattern it teaches.

pages.title: Transcribing scrolls
pages.text: Hold a $(item)Blank Scroll$() in your main hand and a coloured $(item)Scroll Ink$() in your offhand, then right-click to draw. Each painted cell spends one ink use. You can switch offhand inks while drawing: every mark keeps its own colour. The final stroke must use the pattern's required ink.
